findings.title: Positive model shrinkage is accepted without checking reviewed physical dimensions
findings.seed: J410 model m_Scale x/y/z = 0.01; all native pads, tracks and parts unchanged
findings.full_path_limit: The entire 31-rule R10 contract rejects stale F9 inputs and r10_parts --check rejects stale board-bound budget; no tools/check.sh escape was demonstrated. The current native model has the correct maximum envelope.

source.basis: Existing D-R11-01 reviewed T0-1 maximum envelope; this lens probes its checker identity rather than requalifying the maker drawing.

findings.fix: Validate normalized physical extents and pose of reviewed terminal/SD model envelopes, allowing genuine unit conversions only when the resulting dimensions agree. Add a positive finite shrink seed alongside the existing invalid-transform regressions.

findings.title: K-inner omits connected foreign-net drawings and zones
findings.full_path_limit: Official native all-severity DRC/parity and all other R10 rules pass both connected mutants. Full route scan plus bump search was run for the zone mutant only. Both still fail F9-1 and the board-bound budget check; no whole-gate escape was demonstrated. The initial disconnected graphic/zone variants were independently caught by native unconnected/island checks.
findings.fix: Extend K-inner through the existing complete copper representation walk to board/footprint zones and copper drawings, with explicit treatment of legitimate through-hole pads/vias. Keep In1 GND-only and In2 power/GND-only policy independent of the serialization class; seed connected variants so DRC isolation cannot mask a checker miss.

findings.title: S-4 accepts a present required BOM reference with Qty zero
findings.seed: Copy the real JLC BOM; change only the U1 row Qty from 1 to 0. Keep Designator=U1 and the native PCB, schematic and CPL unchanged.
findings.full_path_limit: This is a presence-check limitation, not evidence that an assembler would omit U1. The existing bound package rejects the modified CSV, and current exporter output has correct quantities. A future export bug plus a freshly generated matching manifest would need separate production-path validation; that path was not manufactured or claimed here.
findings.fix: When a BOM supplies Qty, validate that it is positive and equals the number of distinct designators in the row, reusing the existing S-4 CSV walk. Preserve the quantity-free CPL schema.

closed_prior_findings.evidence: All 23 terminal pins, each with wrong role/polarity, hidden and footprint-textbox duplicate mutations: 69/69 rejected.
DNP for every 199 required part plus 33 additional native exclusion flags: 232/232 rejected. Ten real BOM/CPL omission cases rejected.
Zero/negative/NaN scaling of seven terminals and J430: 24/24 rejected by fit. The new positive finite shrink issue is separate.

execution_summary.native_cli_reservation: released after the seven baseline/mutant runs

scope_amendments: Single external screw switch, no J124/pull-pin; PC1 independent load-switch enable and PE4 fire; post-Q120/Q121 RAW_ACT bus retained.
AUD-2 omits only named slow return geometry; critical hygiene still gates. Actual ACT_EN_MCU off-angle seed is rejected.
AUD-10 exact duplicate/collinear/inside-pad/distance residuals are informational; the partial-overlap seed is rejected.
Audit2 all199 native fitted population, sole PC5 sense/direct ADC tails, GND-only In1 routing, optional plate and local-clearance rules respected.
GAP-3 two VIPPO vias, GAP-4 post-reflow C84 and GAP-5 20ms/36ms obligations remain; this lens does not physically qualify them.
coverage_limits: No complete tools/check.sh or canonical build, no source/CAD implementation change, no git action, no current-round peer report read, no owner question.
No complete fabrication regeneration; current five-output manifest was verified and genuine corrupt/missing/malformed outputs/manifest variants were exercised on isolated copies.
No firmware, bench, thermal, e-match, physical fit, vibration, order or supplier-stock qualification.

No whole-gate escape demonstrated. Selected-rule misses were followed through the entire 31-rule R10 contract, native DRC/parity and board-bound budget check as stated, but the untouched production shell was not rerun.
No fake CLI or substituted real-board gate. Native JSON produced by official10.0.7 is retained in the evidence below; CLI return0 alone is not a pass when JSON contains violations/unconnected items.
Positive normalized model sizing and foreign inner copper findings concern prospective future inputs; neither seeded condition is present on this PCB.
